description: List unacknowledged A2A messages waiting in the grok inbox. Idempotent — fetching twice is safe. Call this when the inbox webhook fires. Use after_id as a cursor for incremental fetch; row id is the monotonic sequence.

after_id.description: return only rows with id greater than this (cursor)

wake_id.description: optional: the X-AgentTransmit-Wake-Id of the wake that prompted this read. Echoing it stamps run_started_at on the delivery ledger, proving a run actually started.

name: transmit_inbox
